card.name: Linking words before added amounts
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" or "additional" that come right before an extra amount or quantity, and sometimes digits or punctuation inside numeric tables and formulas.

modes.label: Linking word before an amount
modes.description: "of" or "additional" sits just before a further quantity or named substance in a dosing or count statement.
modes.example: The number of voting representatives is currently set at 435. There are an<< additional>> five delegates to the House of Representatives.

modes.label: Inside numeric tables
modes.description: A digit or decimal point within a row of numbers in a data table or formula.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on small words like "of" or "additional" just before an extra amount, and on digits inside number tables.
